# Reanimate

> Reanimate is an AI-powered tool that turns your app into animated, motion-designed marketing videos. Go from app to publish-ready product video in minutes.

## What is Reanimate?

Reanimate is a web-based AI video generation tool purpose-built for app developers, SaaS founders, and product marketers. It generates animated, motion-designed product videos directly from your app — no video editing or motion design experience required.

## Use Cases

- App demo videos for product launches
- Animated marketing videos for SaaS and mobile apps
- Social media video content (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok)
- App store preview videos
- Product walkthrough videos
- Feature announcement videos
- Pitch deck video clips

## Who uses Reanimate?

App developers, SaaS founders, indie hackers, product marketers, and startup teams who need professional-quality marketing videos without hiring a motion designer or video editor. Customers include teams at Microsoft, Amazon, LinkedIn, PhonePe, Flipkart, and Sarvam.

## Key Features

- AI-generated animated product videos from your app
- Natural language video editing (describe the change, AI does the rest)
- Smart zoom, screen pan, and click ripple animations
- Automated captions
- Voiceover generation
- Smart trim (removes dead time automatically)
- Live real-time collaboration
- Visual edit: click, drag, and resize elements
- Unlimited exports

## Alternatives

Reanimate is an AI-native alternative to: Loom, Screen Studio, Rotato, Descript, After Effects, ScreenFlow, Kite, Veed.io — specifically for creating animated, motion-designed app marketing videos.

## Pricing

- Creator: $25/month — 5 active projects, 100GB storage, full AI editing
- Pro: $100/month — Unlimited projects, 1TB storage, priority support
- Teams: Custom pricing — Real-time collaboration, SAML/SSO, unlimited storage
- All plans include a 7-day free trial
